description:
An API key of a `NotifyServiceAccount`, minted by the operator through
the instance's key issuer and written to `secretTargets` as
`NOTIFY_API_KEY` (`wnk_…`) and `NOTIFY_URL`.

A key can't be read back: a lost target, a new
`notify.weebo.io/rotate-secret` value, or a change of the service
account, scopes or channels mints a new key. The new key is written to
every target before the previous one is revoked. Deleting the CR
revokes its key and deletes its targets; deleting the service account
revokes it too.

channels.description: The channel ids the key may act in.

instanceRef.description:
The instance: unset, the only one of this namespace. An instance of
another namespace must accept this one
(`objectSelector.namespaces`).

kind.description: The kind of instance a reference designates.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: namespace only applies to kind LocalInstance

scopes.description:
What the key may do. Notify refuses a scope the service account
doesn't hold in every channel listed.

items.description: What a principal may do in a channel.

secretTargets.description:
Defaults to one target named after the CR, in its namespace, on the
operator's default backend (`secretStore.defaultBackend` of its
chart). A Vault target uses the operator's Vault connection and
stays under `<pathPrefix>/<namespace>/`.

items.description:
Where an emitted secret (generated password or key, OAuth2 credentials,
access token) is written. A CR may list several targets — the same
value is fanned out to each.

backend.description:
`kubernetes` (default) or `vault`. A Vault target reuses the Vault
connection (address, mount, auth) the instance configures, which it
must then do.

name.description:
Kubernetes: the `Secret` name. Vault: names the default path
`<pathPrefix>/<namespace>/<name>` when `path` is unset.

namespace.description:
Kubernetes `Secret` namespace (Vault: the namespace segment of the
default path). Defaults to the CR's own namespace; required on
cluster-scoped CRs. A namespaced CR may only name its own namespace.

path.description:
Vault only: explicit KV v2 path under the instance's mount. It must
stay under `<pathPrefix>/<namespace>/` (this object's namespace, or
the target's on a cluster-scoped object), unless the instance's
`pathGrants` open it to this object.

serviceAccountRef.description:
The `NotifyServiceAccount` of this namespace the key acts as, bound
to the same instance.
